name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport catering wasn't exactly planned. He started his career in a small family-owned restaurant in Lima, mastering traditional Peruvian cuisine. A chance encounter with a Formula 1 team during a promotional event sparked his interest. He was captivated by the high-pressure environment and the need for top-notch, consistent service, even trackside.

Ricardo believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. He focuses on providing nutritious, delicious meals that cater to diverse dietary needs and preferences, ensuring that everyone from the mechanics to the drivers are at their peak performance. His attention to detail and ability to create a sense of community within the team has made him an invaluable asset at Mercedes-AMG. He takes great pride in his ability to bring a little piece of home to the track, no matter where in the world they are racing. He is known for his inventive use of local ingredients during race weekends, bringing new and delicious dishes to the team's repertoire.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man of medium height, with a warm smile that puts everyone at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small bag of coca leaves for altitude sickness, even at sea level.
Insists on preparing his own 'aji amarillo' hot sauce for the team's meals.
Has a specific, elaborate ritual for cleaning his knives before each meal preparation.
